∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (μ ν : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (w v : ℕ → ℝ),
  Summable w →
    Summable v →
      ∑' (i : ℕ), w i = 1 →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (μ i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i))) →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (ν i) Filter.atTop (nhds (v i))) →
            (∀ (K : ℕ),
                ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ν i N ≤ a N ∧
                    a N ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ν i N + 1 - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, μ i N) →
              Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' (i : ℕ), v i))
∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) (N : ℕ), ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency P N = ↑(Finset.filter P (Finset.range N)).card / ↑N

∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) (N : ℕ),
  ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency P N =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit P) N

∀ (P Q : ℕ → Prop) (d : ℝ),
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, P n ↔ Q n) →
    Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency Q) Filter.atTop (nhds d) →
      Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency P) Filter.atTop (nhds d)

∀ (label : ℕ → ℕ) (K n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i) n = if label n < K then 1 else 0
∀ (bad : ℕ → Prop) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ), ExternalO3CountablePartition.selectedWeight bad w i = if bad i then w i else 0

∀ (label : ℕ → ℕ) (fails bad : ℕ → Prop) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i)) →
    (∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), M ≤ n → label n = i → (fails n ↔ bad i)) →
      Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i ∧ fails n) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (ExternalO3CountablePartition.selectedWeight bad w i))

∀ (label : ℕ → ℕ) (fails : ℕ → Prop) (K n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i ∧ fails m) n =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m < K ∧ fails m) n

∀ (u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (K N : ℕ),

∀ (x : ℕ) (x_1 : Fin (x + 1) → ℕ) (x_2 : Fin x → ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralBlockWords.blockWord x x_1 x_2 =
    match x, x_1, x_2 with
    | 0, x, x_3 => []
    | m.succ, lengths, exits =>
      List.replicate (lengths 0 - 1) 1 ++
        exits 0 :: ExternalO3GeneralBlockWords.blockWord m (fun i => lengths i.succ) fun i => exits i.succ

∀ (m : ℕ) (lengths : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (exits : Fin m → ℕ),
  (ExternalO3GeneralBlockWords.blockWord m lengths exits).sum + lengths (Fin.last m) =
    ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinedExponent m lengths exits

∀ (r ℓ κ : ℕ) (tail : List ℕ) (x : ℕ),
  ExternalO3Spec.IsOddSeed x →
    1 ≤ ℓ →
      2 ≤ κ →
        (ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r (List.replicate (ℓ - 1) 1 ++ κ :: tail) x ↔
          ExternalO3Spec.blockLength x = ℓ ∧
            ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) = κ ∧
              ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r tail (ExternalO3Spec.nextBlock x))

∀ (ℓ κ x : ℕ),
  2 ≤ κ →
    ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) = κ →
      ¬2 ≤ ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) → False
∀ (ℓ κ x : ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ExternalO3Spec.blockLength x = ℓ → ∀ t < ℓ - 1, ¬t + 1 < ℓ → False

∀ (x ℓ : ℕ),
  1 ≤ ℓ →
    ExternalO3Spec.blockLength x = ℓ →
      ExternalO3Spec.stride (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) = ExternalO3Spec.nextBlock x

∀ (x i : ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.futureBlockSeed (ExternalO3Spec.nextBlock x) i =
    ExternalO3GeneralDraft.futureBlockSeed x (i + 1)

∀ (j r : ℕ) (tail : List ℕ) (x : ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r (List.replicate j 1 ++ tail) x ↔
    (∀ t < j, ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[t] x) = 1) ∧
      ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r tail (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[j] x)
∀ (j x t : ℕ), t + 1 < j + 1 → ¬t < j → False
∀ (j : ℕ), ¬0 < j + 1 → False
∀ (j t : ℕ), t < j → ¬t + 1 < j + 1 → False

∀ (m : ℕ) (lengths : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (exits : Fin m → ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ValidBlockData m lengths exits →
    ∀ (x : ℕ),
      ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedCell m lengths exits x ↔
        ExternalO3Spec.IsOddSeed x ∧
          ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell (lengths (Fin.last m))
            (ExternalO3GeneralBlockWords.blockWord m lengths exits) x

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (n : ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.label h n =
    if 2 ≤ ExternalO3Spec.blockLength (2 * n + 1) then
      Sum.inl (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ascendingOffsets h (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.window h (2 * n + 1)))
    else
      Sum.inr
        (ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (2 * n + 1) - 2,
          ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveOffsets h
            (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.window h (ExternalO3Spec.stride (2 * n + 1))))

∀ (φ : ExternalO3Spec.Correction) (w : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Window ExternalO3GeneralDraft.depthOne),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.liftOne φ w = φ (w (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.zeroIndex ExternalO3GeneralDraft.depthOne))
∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) (N : ℕ), ExternalO3GeneralDraft.populationFrequency P N = ↑(Finset.filter P (Finset.range N)).card / ↑N

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (w : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Window h) (i : Fin ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveOffsets h w i = w i - 1

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (b : Fin ↑h → ℕ) (i : Fin ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveWindow h b i = b i + 1

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (data : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedIndex ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinementProjection h data =
    if 2 ≤ ExternalO3GeneralDraft.decodedLengths (↑h) data ⟨0, ⋯⟩ then
      Sum.inl
        (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ascendingOffsets h fun i => ExternalO3GeneralDraft.decodedLengths (↑h) data i.castSucc)
    else
      Sum.inr
        (data.2 (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.zeroIndex h),
          ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveOffsets h fun i => ExternalO3GeneralDraft.decodedLengths (↑h) data i.succ)

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (φ : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Correction h) (e : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Edge h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.selectedWeight h φ e =
    if ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Bad h φ e then ExternalO3GeneralDraft.weight h e else 0

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (a : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.AscendingIndex h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.weight h (Sum.inl a) =
    2 ^ (-↑(ExternalO3GeneralDraft.windowSum h (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ascendingWindow h a)))

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (k : ℕ) (b : Fin ↑h → ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.weight h (Sum.inr (k, b)) =
    2 ^ (-↑(k + 2 + ExternalO3GeneralDraft.windowSum h (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveWindow h b)))

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (x : ℕ) (i : Fin ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.window h x i = ExternalO3Spec.blockLength (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.futureBlockSeed x ↑i)

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (w : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Window h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.windowSum h w = ∑ i, w i
∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth), 0 < ↑h
∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth), ExternalO3GeneralDraft.zeroIndex h = ⟨0, ⋯⟩

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (x : ℕ),
  ExternalO3Spec.IsOddSeed x →
    2 ≤ ExternalO3Spec.blockLength x →
      ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ascendingWindow h
          (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ascendingOffsets h (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.window h x)) =
        ExternalO3GeneralDraft.window h x

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (a : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.AscendingIndex h)
  (d : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedIndex ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinedFiberWeight h (Sum.inl a) d =
    (if (fun i => d.1 i.castSucc) = ExternalO3GeneralMarginal.ascendingCode h a then
        ExternalO3GeneralWeights.productWeight (↑h + 1) d.1
      else 0) *
      ExternalO3GeneralWeights.productWeight (↑h) d.2

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (d : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedIndex ↑h)
  (a : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.AscendingIndex h),
  (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinementProjection h d = Sum.inl a) =
    ((fun i => d.1 i.castSucc) = ExternalO3GeneralMarginal.ascendingCode h a)

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (a : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.AscendingIndex h),
  ∑' (d : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedIndex ↑h), ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinedFiberWeight h (Sum.inl a) d =
    ExternalO3GeneralDraft.weight h (Sum.inl a)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a : ℕ → ℝ) (μ ν : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (w v : ι → ℝ),
  Summable w →
    Summable v →
      ∑' (i : ι), w i = 1 →
        (∀ (i : ι), Filter.Tendsto (μ i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i))) →
          (∀ (i : ι), Filter.Tendsto (ν i) Filter.atTop (nhds (v i))) →
            (∀ (s : Finset ι),
                ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∑ i ∈ s, ν i N ≤ a N ∧ a N ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ν i N + 1 - ∑ i ∈ s, μ i N) →
              Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' (i : ι), v i))

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (label : ℕ → ι) (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ s, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i) n =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m ∈ s) n

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (bad : ι → Prop) (w : ι → ℝ) (i : ι),
  ExternalO3PartitionGeneral.selectedWeight bad w i = if bad i then w i else 0

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (label : ℕ → ι) (fails : ℕ → Prop) (bad : ι → Prop) (w : ι → ℝ) (i : ι),
  Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i)) →
    (∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), M ≤ n → label n = i → (fails n ↔ bad i)) →
      Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i ∧ fails n) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (ExternalO3PartitionGeneral.selectedWeight bad w i))

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (label : ℕ → ι) (fails : ℕ → Prop) (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ s, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i ∧ fails m) n =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m ∈ s ∧ fails m) n

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (u : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (N : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ s, ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (u i) N =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (fun n => ∑ i ∈ s, u i n) N
